Never again. Got hit with one of those "YOUR COMPUTER IS ABOUT TO BLOW UP" malware "ads" just minding my own business. Any suggestions for even more complete ad blocking besides simple AdBlock? Some sites managed to get popups through my various programs and settings, so this has been a long time coming anyway.
I turned off my ad blocker.
I use ADBlock Pro, Noscript, Ghostery and Random Agent Spoofing. Oh and https everywhere.

Depends on your computer savvy-ness.

I have a router set up running DD-WRT which downloads a list and blocks at the hosts file level. It blocks stuff across my whole network. I still use ad blockers in my browsers even on top of that.
I just use noscript. Pain in the ass to train, and you may give up figuring out what to whitelist on the most script-abusing websites, but good riddance to that.

I personally recommend a combination of ublock origin and privacy badger. The first is pretty damn good at blocking ads, and if it misses something, there's an element picker which lets you teach it what else you don't want to see. Then privacy badger is an addon from the EFF that learns over time what domains are trying to track you, and selectively blocks cookie creation, or outright connections on an individual domain basis for each site you visit.
Unlock origin is better than adblock. I find Umatrix easier than NoScript. And decentraleyes as a backup.
